bio: This simple shop may not be the most atmospheric, but its tasty food in generous portions at affordable prices always attracts a crowd. With a Thai owner and all Thai kitchen team, rest assured that the food is as authentic as can be. The tom yum soup strikes a fine balance between sour, sweet, spicy and salty tastes; the BBQ squid is nicely grilled and loaded with umami, perfect with the hot and sour sauce. Reservation recommended....
